_comment: ADOPTER EXAMPLE (rc.39 · flow-plan Phase 5.4) — one deployment record, mounted as docs/governance/deployments/DEP-2026-0042-01.json and verified by scripts/deployed-digest-check.mjs on the DEPLOY lane. It exists so the lane's first control checks something real: without a record the gate is silent, and a silent gate is exactly the empty lane rc.33 refused. Two bindings make it worth writing. deployed_digest is the digest in docs/governance/release-subject.json — not the same commit, the same ARTIFACT, because a rebuild of the same source is a different thing and it was not the one that was evaluated. And stages_completed replays the service's declared progressive_delivery ramp: same names, same order, same traffic, each having actually baked for at least the declared bake_minutes. In a real adoption this file is WRITTEN BY THE DEPLOY JOB from what it observed, not by a human from what was intended — the same rule the evidence collector follows.
notes: Exposure remained gated by credit.decisioning.enabled throughout: this record says the ARTIFACT reached 100% of hosts, which is deploy. Turning the flag on for a cohort is exposure, and it is governed separately — that separation is the whole of Phase 5.
